in_marathi.name: Agnija
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Agni, the fire deity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Agnija हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Agnija is a Sanskrit name derived from the word Agni, meaning fire. In Hindu mythology, Agnija is the goddess of Agni, the god of fire. She is also known as the wife of Agni, the fire deity, and is revered as the protector of the sacred fire. She is believed to bring prosperity, strength, and protection.
